name: Budgets on rates and on usage outside a plan
what: You set a budget as a rate, such as spend per hour. You also set a budget on the metered usage that is billed outside your plan. A limit on a count, such as new conversations per minute, is set as a rule and is not a budget.

suggest.why: A rate catches a runaway early, and usage billed beyond a plan is paid per call and needs a cap of its own.
